mission_conclusion: TERMINAL: neither of the two genuinely distinct, pre-registered derivatives information families tested (NIFTY futures basis, NIFTY futures OI change) provides meaningful incremental predictive information beyond the already-exhausted OHLCV feature set. This is a substantive negative research result, not a data-availability or infrastructure failure -- real, historically deep, economically verified data was found and used throughout. Real order execution remains disabled; nothing in this research program touched live trading infrastructure.
